# Card G candidate · App release (not swapped in)

**Status: candidate only.** IND-B4 says conditional card G replaces a home tile when its trigger fires. Whether it does is Ranjith's call; the home page still shows cards A–D. Generated by `scripts/card_g_candidate.py` from the public voice (INDIE on Google Play, core licence only).

## Trigger

IND-B4 gives no numeric trigger. The one used here fires for a week when all three hold:

1. at least 15 reviews in the week carry the "App blocked as a security risk" theme;
2. the theme is at least 10% of the week's app reviews;
3. its share on the newest releases (2.5.0, 2.6.0) is at least 5× its share on the previous stable release (2.3.1).

**Result:** the trigger fired in 4 weeks (2026-08-28, 2026-09-04, 2026-09-11, 2026-09-18). In the week to the freeze (2026-10-02) it is **not firing**: 29 items, 8.6% of the week's app reviews.

## What the card would show

- **Title:** "App release 2.5.0: about one review in five says the app blocks the phone as unsafe" (the share at its peak weeks; the live title would bind the week's figure to its L2 id).
- **What moved:** the weekly share of app reviews with the security-block theme, by release, from 10 Aug; release 2.3.1 stays near 1–3% throughout.
- **Themes by app version:** security block ("threat detected", "use a secure operating system", "screen reader"), login and OTP or SIM-binding failures; KYC items are too few to show.
- **Listing rating:** INDIE listing rating, all-time, as of 2026-10-01: 4.5 from 8,17,954 ratings (Google Play). Shown apart from the week's figures.
- **Peer:** greyed "pending verification" (no peer app reviews in the pull).
- **Voice:** paraphrased only; Play replies are near-universal, so "bank replied" is not a differentiator.
- **Owner:** Head of Digital Banking (role), with the CIO and customer service.
- **Drafted action:** review the device-integrity rules shipped in 2.5.0 against the phones and settings customers name (Android 16, HyperOS, screen-reader and accessibility services, developer options), publish a workaround in the store reply, and track the weekly share back under 3% before the next release. Approver: Head of Digital Banking.
- **Not on the card:** any count of affected customers (reviews are not incidence), any claim about cause beyond what reviewers report, and any figure blended across stores.
